title: Cosmic Blue Muse
description: A vibrant surreal painting featuring a large blue stylized face with yellow eyes floating in a swirling cosmic vortex of blue, purple and orange. Below, a multicolored woman's profile with flowing rainbow hair merges with a black wolf with glowing yellow eyes and an elderly man wearing a fedora, glasses and a face mask. Pink flowers, lightning bolts, and dramatic clouds fill the scene above a mountain range.
